A. The Lessor has the appropriate authority to lease the Property and to enter into the Contract with the Lessee.

B. The Lessee has subsequently agreed to enter this contract to further define both parties’rights and obligations regarding the Property.

1 INTERPRETATION

In this contract, words and expressions set out in page 1 and schedule 1. The obligation of the Lessee binds each of their occupants and the Lessee is liable for any breach by them of any term of this Contract.

2. LEAS PERIOD
2.1 The Lessee has to lease the Apartment from the Lessor for the Lease period and for the permitted use only, as permitted by the Rules of this Contract. Any renewal and/or nonrenewal of the contract by the Lessee shall require the Lessee to give the Lessor a Written Notice two (2) months prior to the expiry of the Lease period wherein the Rent shall be mutually determined by the Lessor in accordance with the applicable Laws.
2.2 Should the Lessee fail to serve the written notice as per the provision of clause 2.1 above, a penalty equal to the Rent of two (2) months shall be imposed.
2.3 The Lessee agrees to allow the Lessor or its authorized agent to enter the Apartment, where necessary and all responsible times during the Lease period on up to twenty-four (24) hours prior notice, or in emergency, without notice to inspect the Apartment.
3. FINANCIAL MATTERS
3.1 In consideration for the Lease of the Apartment, The Lessee shall pay the Rent to the Lessor as further specified in the page 1 of this Contract.
3.2 The Lessee shall be responsible for settlement of all costs associated with Utility, Sewerage Consumption, Connection, Maintenance, Telephone and Television/Satellite of whatever nature of other costs, taxes and VAT (Value Added Tax) specified in the Rules and/or by the competent authorities.
3.3 The Lessee is obliged to pay the Sewerage Charges to the Lessor as per the Sewerage Fee Schedule in Page 7 of 7.
3.4 The Lessee shall pay as specified in this contract:
a. A security deposit to the Lessor upon signing this contract. The Security deposit is to be refunded to the Lessee upon the expiry or termination of this contract provided the Lessee in both instances has also vacated the Apartment, subject to clause 3.6.
b. The Rent to the Lessor
c. Other Fees to the Lessor mentioned in RESIDENTIAL FEES SCHEDULE on Page 6 of 7
3.5 Should the Lessee fail to duly vacate the Apartment as per the applicable law within a maximum period of fifteen (15) days from the expiry of the Lease Period, a penalty equal to the rent for two (2) months shall be imposed along with the due rent from the expiry of the Lease Period until the actual date of eviction and proper handover.
3.6 Before refunding the Security Deposit, the Lessor may make deductions from the Security Deposit to cover any outstanding dues owed to the Lessor or for any damage or defect in the Property & Apartment which the Lessor will need to rectify and/or carry out, except normal wear and tear. The Lessor shall notify the Lessee prior to the deduction of the cost of damages or defects or any dues in writing. In case the Lessee does not confirm their acceptance of the deduction within ten (10) days of the notification, the Lessor will have the right to process the deduction without referring back to the Lessee. In all cases where the amount exceeds the actual Security Deposit, The Lessee will be liable to settle the full amount due to the Lessor plus, any outstanding rent till this amount is settled in full.
3.7 In the event where the damages caused by the Lessee to the Property or Apartment needs a period of more than Fourteen (14) days to be rectified, the Lessee shall in addition to the rectifying cost pay the Lessor a Penalty equivalent to the rent for the period needed to rectify the damages from the Expiry date of the Lease period, and the same shall be calculated based on the last annual rent paid.
4. REPAIR AND MAINTENANCE
4.1 The Lessee shall keep the Apartment in a good state of repair and condition, or it shall appoint the Lessor and/or the Lessor’s authorized agent to carry out the aforesaid on its behalf. The Lessee will be liable for any loss or damage to any part of the Apartment for any reason
4.2 The Lessee shall not be permitted to alter or renovate any part of the Apartment. The Lessee shall ensure that the rules are fully adhered to all at all times.
5 USE OF THE PROPERTY
5.1 The Lessee undertakes that the Apartment is for single-family accommodation (max. adults allowed is 4 in 1BHK and 6 in 2BHK) and not to sub-lease or assign. In case if the Lessee violates, the Lessor shall be entitled to vacate the leased Apartment.
5.2 The Lessee shall only be permitted to use the Apartment for the Permitted Use and in accordance with the Rules. The Lessee shall not to do anything at the Property which is illegal or immoral or which creates an unreasonable disturbance or annoyance to other occupiers in the nearby vicinity of the Apartment. The Lessee is prohibited unless the Lessor grants its written permission for keeping Pets or other animal in the Apartment, bringing upon the Apartment any machinery, equipment or goods of such size and weight as to be likely in the opinion of the Lessor to cause any structural or other damage to the Apartment and Building
5.3 The Lessee agrees not to shift furniture or any heavy objects in or out of the Apartment except through the use of the service lift available and within such reasonable times as may be determined by the Lessor. The Lessee may not suspend heavy loads from the ceiling, main structure, walls, and shall not suffer floors to be loaded beyond the safety limits.
5.4 The Lessee at the time of entering this Contract acknowledges examining and duly inspecting the condition of the Apartment, and is satisfied that the Apartment is in good,safe and leasable condition for the purpose of this contract and the Lessee acknowledges receiving the Apartment at the date of signature. The Lessee when handing the Apartment back to the Lessor shall do so in the same or better condition as it was when at the commencement of the Lease period.
5.5 The Lessee undertakes not to carry out any improvements, replacements, alterations, additions, divisions, demarcation to the Apartment, and shall not cause any changes, replacements and additions to the electrical wiring, sanitary or other pipes, ducts and appliances inside Apartment.
5.6 6 The Lessee is not allowed to:
a. Stick fitted carpets onto any place in the Apartment
b. Install private dish antennas
c. Keep drying cloths rope hanged and store goods in the balcony
6. TERMINATION
6.1 This Contract shall remain valid and effective till its expiry date and may be terminated by the Lessor in the following cases:
a. If the Rent amount or any part of it, is at any time in arrears and unpaid for the Thirty (30) days after the same has become due or
b. On any of the grounds and for any of the reasons set in the Rental Law (as amended) of the Emirate where the Apartment is located or any grounds permitted under any other law that amends or repeals or replaces the said Law.
6.2 In the case the Lessee is desirous to Terminate the Contract and to vacate the Leased Apartment before the expiry date, the Lessee shall:
a. Serve Sixty (60) days written notice prior to his vacation of the demised Apartment.
b. The Lessee shall be fully liable for the rental amount till the demised Apartment is rented to another tenant.
c. Pay water and electricity bills and handover the apartment keys and parking access card to the Property Management.
d. Recover the Security Deposit.
6.3 Upon the termination, the Lessor shall be entitled to retain the Security Deposit in full and to receive any payment of any amounts due and owing from the Lessee calculated up to the expiry date in addition to interest on any overdue payment together with the right to enter the Apartment and to lease the Apartment to another Lessee.
6.4 On vacating the Apartment, the Lessee shall be required to remove all the Lessee’s personal belongings at the Lessee’s expense and ensure that the Apartment is clean and, in the condition, it was at the commencement of the Lease period, except normal wear and tear. The Lessee shall make good all damage caused by such removal.
6.5 The Contract will not be terminated and shall remain valid where the Lessee is still occupying the Apartment or the Lessees’ furniture is not removed even if the water and electricity clearance or Apartment Keys are handed over to the Lessor officially and in writing, and the Lessee is obliged to pay the rent to the Lessor till the Apartment is totally and officially vacant as per the Applicable Laws.
7. OTHER MATTERS
7.1 Any notice or communication under or in connection with this Contract shall be written in English or Arabic and may be delivered personally to the Lessee for the purpose of this Contract or email to the Lessee sue to receive the notice.
7.2 The Parties agree that the notices shall be served at the addresses specified on Page 1 of 1 of the Contract.
7.3 In the event of a discrepancy or conflict between The English and Arabic text of this contract, the Arabic text shall prevail, but due consideration shall be given to the English text in interpreting the Arabic text.
7.4 This Contract shall be governed and constructed in accordance with, the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the applicable Emirate where the Apartment is Located. Any dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with this Contract shall be finally settled by the resolution procedures directed by the applicable Laws of the Emirate where the Apartment is located and the Lessee shall bear all legal costs incurred by the Lessor.

SCHEDULE 1

Definitions

In this schedule 1 to the Contract, unless the context otherwise requires the following expressions have the follow meanings:

“Property”

Means the property named and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Apartment”

Means the Unit Number and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Lessor”

Means the Landlord and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Lessee”

Means the Tenant Name and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Lease Period”

A period commencing from the “Lease Commencement Date” defined on Page 1 of 1 until the “Lease Expiry Date” defined on Page 1 of 1, wherein the total Lease Period shall not exceed One (1) year.

“Permitted Use”

The Apartment shall be used strictly for Residential purpose.

“Rent”

The rent shall be payable by the Lessee to the Lessor at a rate as stated in Page 1 of 1

“Security Deposit”

An amount payable at the commencement of the Lease Period to the Lessor, the amount is set on Page 1 of 1.

“Administration Fees”

Means the fees that the Lessee is liable to pay directly to the lessor as described in the Fee Schedule on Page 6 of 7.

5.1 The Lessee undertakes that the Apartment is for single-family accommodation (max. adults allowed is 4 in 1BHK and 6 in 2BHK) and not to sub-lease or assign. In case if the Lessee violates, the Lessor shall be entitled to vacate the leased Apartment.
5.2 The Lessee shall only be permitted to use the Apartment for the Permitted Use and in accordance with the Rules. The Lessee shall not to do anything at the Property which is illegal or immoral or which creates an unreasonable disturbance or annoyance to other occupiers in the nearby vicinity of the Apartment. The Lessee is prohibited unless the Lessor grants its written permission for keeping Pets or other animal in the Apartment, bringing upon the Apartment any machinery, equipment or goods of such size and weight as to be likely in the opinion of the Lessor to cause any structural or other damage to the Apartment and Building
5.3 The Lessee agrees not to shift furniture or any heavy objects in or out of the Apartment except through the use of the service lift available and within such reasonable times as may be determined by the Lessor. The Lessee may not suspend heavy loads from the ceiling, main structure, walls, and shall not suffer floors to be loaded beyond the safety limits.
5.4 The Lessee at the time of entering this Contract acknowledges examining and duly inspecting the condition of the Apartment, and is satisfied that the Apartment is in good,safe and leasable condition for the purpose of this contract and the Lessee acknowledges receiving the Apartment at the date of signature. The Lessee when handing the Apartment back to the Lessor shall do so in the same or better condition as it was when at the commencement of the Lease period.
5.5 The Lessee undertakes not to carry out any improvements, replacements, alterations, additions, divisions, demarcation to the Apartment, and shall not cause any changes, replacements and additions to the electrical wiring, sanitary or other pipes, ducts and appliances inside Apartment.
5.6 6 The Lessee is not allowed to:
a. Stick fitted carpets onto any place in the Apartment
b. Install private dish antennas
c. Keep drying cloths rope hanged and store goods in the balcony
6. TERMINATION
6.1 This Contract shall remain valid and effective till its expiry date and may be terminated by the Lessor in the following cases:
a. If the Rent amount or any part of it, is at any time in arrears and unpaid for the Thirty (30) days after the same has become due or
b. On any of the grounds and for any of the reasons set in the Rental Law (as amended) of the Emirate where the Apartment is located or any grounds permitted under any other law that amends or repeals or replaces the said Law.
6.2 In the case the Lessee is desirous to Terminate the Contract and to vacate the Leased Apartment before the expiry date, the Lessee shall:
a. Serve Sixty (60) days written notice prior to his vacation of the demised Apartment.
b. The Lessee shall be fully liable for the rental amount till the demised Apartment is rented to another tenant.
c. Pay water and electricity bills and handover the apartment keys and parking access card to the Property Management.
d. Recover the Security Deposit.
6.3 Upon the termination, the Lessor shall be entitled to retain the Security Deposit in full and to receive any payment of any amounts due and owing from the Lessee calculated up to the expiry date in addition to interest on any overdue payment together with the right to enter the Apartment and to lease the Apartment to another Lessee.
6.4 On vacating the Apartment, the Lessee shall be required to remove all the Lessee’s personal belongings at the Lessee’s expense and ensure that the Apartment is clean and, in the condition, it was at the commencement of the Lease period, except normal wear and tear. The Lessee shall make good all damage caused by such removal.
6.5 The Contract will not be terminated and shall remain valid where the Lessee is still occupying the Apartment or the Lessees’ furniture is not removed even if the water and electricity clearance or Apartment Keys are handed over to the Lessor officially and in writing, and the Lessee is obliged to pay the rent to the Lessor till the Apartment is totally and officially vacant as per the Applicable Laws.
7. OTHER MATTERS
7.1 Any notice or communication under or in connection with this Contract shall be written in English or Arabic and may be delivered personally to the Lessee for the purpose of this Contract or email to the Lessee sue to receive the notice.
7.2 The Parties agree that the notices shall be served at the addresses specified on Page 1 of 1 of the Contract.
7.3 In the event of a discrepancy or conflict between The English and Arabic text of this contract, the Arabic text shall prevail, but due consideration shall be given to the English text in interpreting the Arabic text.
7.4 This Contract shall be governed and constructed in accordance with, the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the applicable Emirate where the Apartment is Located. Any dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with this Contract shall be finally settled by the resolution procedures directed by the applicable Laws of the Emirate where the Apartment is located and the Lessee shall bear all legal costs incurred by the Lessor.

SCHEDULE 1

Definitions

In this schedule 1 to the Contract, unless the context otherwise requires the following expressions have the follow meanings:

“Property”

Means the property named and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Apartment”

Means the Unit Number and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Lessor”

Means the Landlord and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Lessee”

Means the Tenant Name and described in Page 1 of 1.

“Lease Period”

A period commencing from the “Lease Commencement Date” defined on Page 1 of 1 until the “Lease Expiry Date” defined on Page 1 of 1, wherein the total Lease Period shall not exceed One (1) year.

“Permitted Use”

The Apartment shall be used strictly for Residential purpose.

“Rent”

The rent shall be payable by the Lessee to the Lessor at a rate as stated in Page 1 of 1

“Security Deposit”

An amount payable at the commencement of the Lease Period to the Lessor, the amount is set on Page 1 of 1.

“Administration Fees”

Means the fees that the Lessee is liable to pay directly to the lessor as described in the Fee Schedule on Page 6 of 7.
